effect.purpose: Read-only Effect v4 source pinned to the tag matching the effect catalog — the authority on what v4 actually exports, plus the v3→v4 migration notes and the @effect/vitest reference implementation. Tracks the main Effect-TS/effect monorepo (v4 development moved back there on 2026-07-19 when the effect-smol repo was archived); vendored at .repos/effect since the 2026-07-24 rename, matching the path a consuming repo would use.

orientation.layout: Sparse checkout: packages/effect (core source + package.json exports map), packages/vitest (@effect/vitest reference implementation), migration/ (per-domain v3→v4 notes), ai-docs/, LLMS.md, MIGRATION.md.
orientation.startHere:
packages/effect/src settles what v4 actually exports (evidence-ladder rung 2); migration/*.md settles v3→v4 renames (rung 1). Before trusting an answer, check the pin matches the installed effect version — node_modules wins on disagreement.

Services/tags live in Context.ts (there is no ServiceMap.ts on the v4 line). Key consumer-side fact settled there: Context.Key<Id, Shape> extends Effect<Shape, never, Id> — v4 tags/Service classes are still first-class Effects, flatMap-able without .asEffect().

notes.note: JSON Schema lowering changed at rc.118 (verified by probe). (1) Anonymous duplicate subschemas are no longer hoisted: beta.107 moved a structurally identical subschema occurring 3+ times into a generated `Union_` definition, but rc.118 inlines it; only an explicit `identifier` annotation produces a shared definition. (2) Schema.toJsonSchemaDocument's `onExcessProperty` option defaults to "ignore", which emits open objects (`additionalProperties: true`); pass `{ onExcessProperty: "error" }` to keep a published schema closed. (3) Schema.isPattern exports `pattern` only when the RegExp has the `u` flag. (4) Single-check `allOf` wrappers are flattened into the parent node.

effected.purpose: Read-only @effected kit source pinned to the installed @effected/github-actions release — the authority on the kit's real export surface (packages/<name>/src/index.ts) and intended usage (each package's CLAUDE.md) for the three packages this action is built on.

orientation.layout: Sparse checkout of the three kit packages this action uses: packages/github-actions (Action.run, ActionInput/Outputs/State/Logger, GitHubToken), packages/github (GitHubClient, GitHubApp, Repo, GitHubError), packages/config-file (ConfigFile.read + JsonCodec).
orientation.startHere: packages/<name>/src/index.ts is the real export surface; packages/<name>/CLAUDE.md is the intended usage. Check the pin tag matches node_modules/@effected/github-actions/package.json — node_modules wins on disagreement. github and config-file are released from the same repo, so their source at this tag is what the catalog ships alongside github-actions.
